locations.note: Immortal John Yesterday and Pauline run an antiques business in present-day Paris and hunt a lost artefact.
A lead on the Book of the Flesh takes John to a New York author before he is kidnapped.
The historical opening takes place in Spain during the Inquisition.
Chapter 5 is spent searching for a hidden book in the Paris catacombs.
John meets his contact near the lake in Central Park.
The sixth chapter, 'Amsterdam and Paris', takes the story to Amsterdam.
